docs.text: 4.2 API message specification The API messages supported by HBee24 are described in this section. API type ID 0x01 : Set Coordinator (command) Direction: Host → HBee24 (Coordinator) This API message determines the operation mode of the network coordinator. HBee24 operates in two modes: Install mode and Operation mode . New devices can join the network in Install mode , but not in Operation mode . The host may allow new devices to join the network during operation by changing the mode from Operation mode to Install mode . Field Description API Type ID 0x01 Message Name Set Coordinator Message Type Command Direction Host → HBee24 (Coordinator) Mode 1 Install mode Mode 2 Operation mode Join Permission Allowed only in Install mode Note To allow a new device to join during operation, the host must switch the coordinator to Install mode. Payload Byte Field Size Description 0 API Type ID 1 byte 0x01 1 Mode 1 byte 0x00 : Operation mode, 0x01 : Install mode
